title: Add a row to every row
starter:
%g    = buffer 6 dtype=i32 slot=0
%bias = buffer 3 dtype=i32 slot=1
%out  = buffer 6 dtype=i32 slot=2
hints: Start from the loop nest in the lesson: `%i = range 2`, `%j = range 3` and the offset `%o = add %i3 %j` with `%i3 = mul %i 3`.
Load the grid element through `shrink %g %o []` and the bias element through `shrink %bias %j []`. Add the two loads and store the sum into `shrink %out %o []`.
Close the inner loop first: `%ej = end %s %j`, then `%ei = end %ej %i`, then `%out1 = after %out %ei`.
explain: Two ranges walk the grid: `%i` over the 2 rows and `%j` over the 3 columns. The offset `i*3 + j` picks the grid element and the output element, and `%j` alone picks the bias element. The store depends on both ranges, so it takes two `end`s: `%j` is closed first and is the inner loop.
